name: Lumen Recorder
author: fasi96
description: Loom-style screen recorder in your bar: area, window or screen, with your mic and one-click sound presets. Optional add-ons, installed only when you switch them on (they ask first, and may ask for your password): remove ums and long pauses with a speech AI, a face bubble, and share links on your own Cloudflare account. Remove with `lumen uninstall` before `omarchy plugin remove io.github.fasi96.lumen`.

barWidget.description: Record the screen, share a link
